claims.evidence: Witness report shows a Canon DSLR body with no readable exact model; sensor size/megapixels are not confirmed from the provided observations.
No performance/specs (FPS) are shown in the witness observations.
No video output or menu/screen showing video specs is shown in the witness observations.
No shutter count readout or diagnostic screen is shown in the witness observations.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Witness report shows the camera body with no lens attached, so lens condition cannot be observed.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show included accessories or any repair history documentation.

risks.risk: Exact camera model is not readable; pricing depends heavily on the specific Canon DSLR generation and features.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number on the camera body (e.g., on the front/top plate) and/or the menu 'About' screen showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified Canon DSLR body (worst-case value for a body-only unit) until the exact model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Body-only shown (lens not attached); missing lens and possibly missing accessories can materially reduce value.
risks.proof: A full set photo showing what is included: lens (if any), battery, charger, strap, cables, manuals/box, and memory card.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only with no lens/accessories beyond what is clearly shown; treat missing items as not included.

risks.risk: Functional status unknown (AF, metering, buttons/dials, ports, viewfinder/LCD).
risks.proof: A short video/clip showing: powering on, menu navigation, autofocus on a moving subject, and playback on the LCD (not just the viewfinder area).
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested/unknown working condition' and assume potential faults until a working test is shown.

risks.risk: Sensor health unknown (dust, dead pixels, fungus) and cleaning status unknown.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank wall at a high f-stop (e.g., f/16) plus a close-up photo of the sensor area (mirror up) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for possible sensor dust/needs cleaning.

risks.risk: Physical condition unknown (scratches, dents, cracks, wear).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front/back, corners, mount area, and top/bottom surfaces under light (including the lens mount contacts/bayonet wear).
risks.if_unproven: Price as having typical used wear; if any damage is later shown, reprice downward.

risks.risk: Shutter count claim cannot be verified; high usage can reduce value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from a shutter-count tool or camera diagnostic screen showing shutter actuations.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher usage (worst-case within reason) until shutter count is proven.

risks.risk: Battery/charger and memory card inclusion and health unknown.
risks.proof: Photos of the exact battery model/label, charger model, and a memory card with capacity; plus a clip showing the camera charging and recording to the card.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming battery/charger may be generic or not included and memory card not included.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Canon model name/number on the body (and/or 'About' page from the menu).
Photos showing everything included in the deal: battery, charger, strap, cables, manuals/box, and whether a lens is included.
A short working test clip: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a moving subject, and playback on the LCD.
A sensor test shot (blank wall at high f-stop) and, if possible, a mirror-up sensor close-up.
A shutter count screenshot/photo from a reliable tool or camera diagnostic screen.
Close-up photos of the lens mount/bayonet contacts and the body for scratches/dents/cracks.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Canon DSLR body, but the exact model and key condition/working proofs (shutter count, sensor health, included accessories, and functionality) are not verifiable from the provided observations. Without those, any worst-case pricing would be too uncertain to be safe.
